Based on the financial evidence provided for FY2024 and FY2025, here is the analysis of Telecom Egypt (ETEL), Commercial International Bank (COMI), Edita Food Industries (EFID), and Talaat Moustafa Group (TMGH).

### 1. Profitability and Growth (2024 to 2025)

*   **Telecom Egypt (ETEL):**
    *   Net profit for the year was 22,578,063,000 EGP for 31/12/2025 and 10,111,328,000 EGP for 31/12/2024 [ETEL-ETEL_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_en-p6-35, ETEL-ETEL_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_en-p6-36].
    *   Basic and diluted earnings per share were 11.93 EGP in 2025 and 4.79 EGP in 2024 [ETEL-ETEL_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_en-p6-55, ETEL-ETEL_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_en-p6-56].
*   **Commercial International Bank (COMI):**
    *   Net profit for the year was 82,258,815,000 EGP for Dec. 31, 2025 and 55,256,732,000 EGP for Dec. 31, 2024 [COMI-COMI_FY2025_consolidated_condensed_en-p5-33, COMI-COMI_FY2025_consolidated_condensed_en-p5-34].
    *   Basic earnings per share were 18.25 EGP in 2025 and 14.72 EGP in 2024 [COMI-COMI_FY2025_consolidated_condensed_en-p5-39, COMI-COMI_FY2025_consolidated_condensed_en-p5-40].
*   **Edita Food Industries (EFID):**
    *   Consolidated net profit for the year was 2,695,301,670 EGP for 31 December 2025 and 1,606,727,698 EGP for 31 December 2024 [EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-30, EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-31].
    *   Basic and diluted earnings per share were 2.18 EGP in 2025 and 1.09 EGP in 2024 [EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-38, EFID-EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-39].
*   **Talaat Moustafa Group (TMGH):**
    *   Consolidated net profit for the year was 18,201,981,482 LE for 2025 and 12,769,517,325 LE for 2024 (Restated) [TMGH-TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en-p7-55, TMGH-TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en-p7-56].
    *   Consolidated gross profit was 20,855,400,384 LE for 2025 and 14,002,196,445 LE for 2024 (Restated) [TMGH-TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en-p7-19, TMGH-TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en-p7-20].
    *   Earnings per share were 6.98 LE in 2025 and 4.38 LE in 2024 (Restated) [TMGH-TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en-p7-61, TMGH-TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en-p7-62].

### 2. Price-to-Earnings (P/E) Ratio

*Share prices at cutoff:* COMI: 128.00 EGP, EFID: 20.40 EGP, ETEL: 141.95 EGP, TMGH: 82.50 EGP.  
*Note: Computing P/E ratios requires share count or direct market capitalization/shares outstanding data which is not provided in the evidence text. Therefore, calculating explicit P/E ratios is omitted due to missing fundamental denominator parameters in the provided evidence set.*

### 3. Balance Sheet, Risks, and Data Quality
*   The provided evidence focuses strictly on income statements (net profits, gross profits, and earnings per share). Balance sheet metrics (such as total assets, liabilities, or debt levels) and specific risk disclosures are absent from the provided text excerpts. 
*   Data quality for the reported profit figures is verified across all four companies via their respective consolidated financial statements.

*Decision Agent Note: Per team guidelines, no recommendation or action is given regarding which stock to purchase.*
